sourceTitle: Chapters in the History of the Insane in the British Isles
description: "Chapters in the History of the Insane in the British Isles" by Daniel Hack Tuke is a historical account written in the late 19th century. The work provides a detailed exploration of the treatment of the insane throughout British history, focusing particularly on key institutions such as Bethlem Hospital and the York Retreat.
